La Caisse nationale des assurances socia: The National Social Security Fund for Salaried Workers (CNAS) and Algérie Poste concluded a framework agreement in Algiers on Tuesday designed to develop digital payment methods. The text was signed by the acting Director General of CNAS, Khaled Khedim, and the Director General of Algérie Poste, Chiraz Bechiri. The two relevant ministers were present at the ceremony.
L'accord prolonge la coopération existan: The agreement extends the existing cooperation between the two institutions. It provides for the interconnection of digital infrastructures, enhanced interoperability, and the securing of data exchanges and financial transactions. The goal is to modernize payments, diversify channels, and facilitate access to the fund's services.
La CNAS et Algérie Poste avaient déjà si: CNAS and Algérie Poste had already signed an agreement in 2024 relating to the exchange of social transfers. Another agreement focused on the supply of 58 electronic payment terminals to the fund's structures. This equipment was intended to streamline transactions and expand the use of digital payment methods.
Les signataires ont souligné la volonté: The signatories emphasized the desire to strengthen coordination between their institutions and improve the quality of public service. They discussed supporting the country's digital transformations and meeting citizens' expectations. Emphasis was placed on supporting social security beneficiaries and employers, as well as facilitating access to services. This approach extends the existing cooperation between the two establishments and aims to achieve concrete results for public services.
